statement: DeepSeek plans to deploy at least 160,000 Huawei Ascend 950DT chips at a new one-gigawatt data center in Ulanqab, Inner Mongolia, partially online by late 2027 or early 2028.
why: A cluster of this size built on domestic Chinese accelerators is demand that merchant GPUs cannot serve, and it validates a non-Nvidia inference stack at scale.

impact.mechanism: Substituting domestic accelerators for inference removes a large block of addressable merchant GPU demand while adding data center and power load in China.

evidence.excerpt: DeepSeek is planning to deploy at least 160,000 of Huawei's Ascend 950DT chips at a new data center in Ulanqab, Inner Mongolia

confidence.basis: Secondary outlet relaying reporting attributed to Bloomberg; no company confirmation or filing.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: statement/trend changed (trend falling -> rising); sources: tech-ish
